methods.name: Site, cohort and net qualification
methods.prerequisites: Eligible unopened cohort, crop identity, qualified mesh and microclimate comparison
methods.required_records: allocation; baseline; mesh/material lot; flower denominator; net integrity
methods.interpretation_guard: Microclimate/ingress uncertainty or untrackable denominator blocks interpretation.

methods.name: Open versus excluded floral access
methods.prerequisites: Randomized matched units; bags before access; explicit pollen/insect permeability
methods.required_records: access intervals; breaches; initial and final fruit outcomes
methods.interpretation_guard: Different mesh changes the causal contrast; pollinator-specific claims require validated exclusion.

methods.name: Single-visit effectiveness
methods.prerequisites: Unvisited receptive flower; witnessed single visit; immediate re-isolation; matched no-visit and hand-cross controls
methods.required_records: visit; floral contact; isolation; pollen or fruit outcome
methods.interpretation_guard: Two visitors or uncertain prior access invalidates single-visit label; destructive pollen cohort separate.

methods.name: Controlled self/cross pollen supplementation
methods.prerequisites: Verified recipient and donor; trained operator; crop-specific isolation and timing SOP
methods.required_records: donor_recipient; pollen transfer time; dose proxy; early set; final harvest; labor
methods.interpretation_guard: Do not generalize genotype thresholds or call anther count a measured pollen-grain dose.

methods.name: Scheduled video and visitor annotation
methods.prerequisites: Validated object-plane optics; schedule/detection audit; no artificial access changes
methods.required_records: clip; usable effort; taxon; confidence; behavior; provenance
methods.interpretation_guard: Video detection supports presence/behavior, not automatically effective pollination or colony attribution.

methods.name: Habitat or colony intervention
methods.prerequisites: Independent treatment/control units; spillover assessment; baseline and concurrent controls
methods.required_records: intervention; colony/substrate metadata; management; weather; harvest; labor
methods.interpretation_guard: Near/far alone or before/after alone may confound effects; no pathogen-bearing substrate deployment by default.

methods.name: Specimen, pollen and compatibility verification
methods.prerequisites: Lab agreement, sampling authorization, chain-of-custody and nondestructive/destructive allocation
methods.required_records: specimen; preservation; microscopy; viable pollen; taxonomic review
methods.interpretation_guard: Preservation can change pollen evidence; separate observed and inferred identity.

methods.name: Fruit fate, harvest, economics and quality
methods.prerequisites: Defined cohort, ripeness, independent replicate, calibrated balance and processing rule
methods.required_records: fruit transitions; harvested mass/count; seed processing; sensory; costs
methods.interpretation_guard: Early set and mature yield are separate; retained fruit is not necessarily marketable yield.
